schedule.placeDetails: Moorish castle above Alfama with views over the Tagus.
schedule.placeDetailsLongDescription: São Jorge Castle crowns the highest hill of the historic centre.
schedule.placeSecretsAndInsights: The camera obscura in the Ulysses Tower runs every half hour.
schedule.activity: Walk the walls of São Jorge Castle

schedule.placeDetails: Terrace with a view over the roofs of Alfama.
schedule.placeDetailsLongDescription: Miradouro de Santa Luzia is a tiled terrace beside a small church.
schedule.placeSecretsAndInsights: Come at sunset and walk down to the Fado houses.
schedule.activity: Watch the sunset from Miradouro de Santa Luzia

schedule.placeDetails: Manueline monastery and UNESCO World Heritage Site.
schedule.placeDetailsLongDescription: Jerónimos Monastery was built to celebrate the voyage of Vasco da Gama.
schedule.placeSecretsAndInsights: The church is free; only the cloister needs a ticket.
schedule.activity: Visit the cloister of Jerónimos Monastery

budgetNotes: About 90 EUR per person per day covers food, transport and entries.
transportationNotes: Tram 28 crosses Alfama; tram 15 runs to Belém.

weather.weatherGeneralNotes: Warm and sunny in mid May.
weather.weatherClothingNotes: Light layers and shoes with grip for the cobblestones.

food.foodGeneralNotes: Seafood, grilled fish and custard tarts.
food.foodBudgetNotes: A prato do dia lunch costs around 12 EUR.

typicalDishes.name: Pastel de nata
typicalDishes.description: Custard tart with a flaky crust, baked very hot and dusted with cinnamon.
